sentences.text: Haematosaurus was a reptile that lived in the ocean.
It belonged to the family Teleosauridae.
Because the fossil record is incomplete, scientists consider this animal a nomen dubium, meaning its identity is uncertain.
Remains were discovered in Boulogne-sur-Mer in northern France.
The species was moved to this new genus in 1934.
This creature lived during the Kimmeridgian stage, between 152.21 and 149.2 million years ago.
